_help: brandName/brandBadge = shop name and badge. brandLogo = picture file (relative to this folder) or a URL; make it with tools\_system\Make-Brand.ps1 (also makes the app icon). machineId empty = use the PC name (e.g. KORI01). apiUrl empty = offline game menu; set it (e.g. http://192.168.51.202:8000/api) when your API server is ready.
